defensives.name: Unending Resolve
defensives.usage_rule: Take 25% less damage for 8 sec on predictable raid damage, and use it to keep casting through interrupts, silences and pushback.

defensives.name: Dark Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Trade 20% of current health for a 20 sec shield worth far more before incoming damage; it is usable through control impairing effects.

defensives.name: Mortal Coil
defensives.usage_rule: Emergency 20% maximum health heal that also horrifies the target for 3 sec, so it doubles as an escape from an add on you.
